position_rules: Words1-23 are11-bit little-endian indices. Word24 holds the remaining3 seed bits (indices0..7); eight padding bits must be zero.
Word25 is an11-bit SHA-512/256 checksum index from the same dictionary; it is not a passphrase or a repeated Monero checksum word. Tessaveil never checks complete user phrases.

external_secret.guidance: Any supported mnemonic passphrase stays outside Tessaveil; wallet login/spending passwords are distinct. Paper27 already includes its nine password words; no extra secret is inferred.

semantic_distinction: Shares BIP39 English words only; legacy32-byte account seed encoding differs from BIP39 and Pera Universal 24 HD. Public tests establish encoding only; no independent wallet recovery demonstrated.
